title: PAH-OMC-003 exact cell-colour block refinement
question: Can a separately versioned finite cell-colour block refinement preserve the PAH finite functional and generator exactly on one common invariant cylinder core without repeating the failed free-vertex, scalar-transport, or conditional-Gibbs routes?
method: Pin the immutable PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-001 parent bytes and define PAH-OMC-003 as a separate successor contract.
For levels n=0,1,2,3 attach a local colour fibre H_n=(Z_(2^n))^C to two labelled cells, use p_n(x,h)=x, and replicate every parent local functional term with weights 1/(2^n).
Lift every parent root by an inverse-closed local colour cocycle, retain parent rates and channel labels, and test gauge and anchor-automorphism equivariance.
Check exact functional equality, projection surjectivity, inverse closure, full-basis generator intertwining, common sup-norm defect and finite cumulative defect.
Run primary, non-importing independent, hostile mutation and integrated Lean lanes while keeping the structural/geometric and physical promotion firewalls active.
finding: The named structural successor passes: normalized local-term replication gives F_n=F_rho, the deterministic lift satisfies p_n r_n=r p_n with inherited rates, and L_n I_n=I_n L_rho exactly on the full finite parent basis at all audited levels. The fibre cardinality grows with q_n, the common sup-norm defect is 0, and every finite cumulative defect is 0. Primary 27/27, independent 28/28, hostile 12/12 mutations rejected, integrated 22/22, and Lean R482 pass.
decision_reason: This is the first repeatable nontrivial finite micro/macro compatibility result after the route-local R-479 free-vertex and R-480 conditional-Gibbs boundaries. The successor adds only a finite colour fibre and root cocycle, keeps the displayed PAH functional and parent rates unchanged, and declares the exact common norm and cumulative criterion. Because the construction does not transport geometric incidence and no limit is taken, it advances only the structural finite substage and leaves the main physical and uniform-limit gates closed.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite structural theorem for PAH-001 + PAH-OMC-001 + PAH-OMC-003. The colour fibre is not a geometric lattice subdivision, physical volume, common infinite-volume automorphism group, continuum approximation, or observation map. The result does not alter the active canonical gate and does not erase the route-local R-479/R-480 failures.
evidence_level: T0 finite exact structural successor with primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean verification; no physical or continuum promotion
